question: Which syllables are invoked to protect the feet and all the limbs?
premises: The syllable yīṃ is invoked to protect the pair of feet
The syllable hsauḥ is invoked to protect all the limbs
inference: Protective syllables are assigned to the feet and to the body as a whole.
plain_english: May the syllable yīṃ protect the pair of feet, and may hsauḥ protect all the limbs.
